owner: user ruling 2026-09-04 (width-void diagnosis) — classes are DATA: add a row + a fixture, never a code branch

declaration.root_override: data-page-root (optional: marks the page container when it is not <main>)
declaration.rail_marker: data-rail (optional: a fixed right column that COUNTS AS CONTENT, not chrome)

reference_viewports.source: ops/environment.md § Display & UI-build premise — 2560x1440 @150% maximised Chrome, external FHD; re-measure when the screen or scaling changes

unknown_policy.promotion_trigger: a page that shipped on an INFERRED class draws a second human layout report -> add the class row (with its fixture) and the page declares it; until then the gate may not FAIL what it cannot determine

defect_left_anchored_cap.definition: right void exceeds left void by more than `asymmetry_frac` of the content width — the page container (or a painted, row-alone block) is capped and hugs the left edge
defect_left_anchored_cap.block_promotion_trigger: the same block class (selector) reported by a human once after shipping -> FAIL for that selector via `block_fail_selectors`

document-short.zh: 短篇閱讀頁（報告、前後對照、owner-view）
document-short.notes: one centred column with symmetric margins; the reading measure is the point, so a wide viewport shows equal void on both sides (an 820px report column is 43% of 1920 — still a deliberate measure, hence the low floor)

document-long.zh: 長篇參考文件（教科書、案卷、討論包）
document-long.notes: fluid main column plus a right rail (data-rail) that carries figures / notes / registry cards; the rail counts as content

deck.notes: each slide is its own area; a text block may not sit narrower than the slide while alone in its row

tool.zh: 操作型 GUI（Chromium 開啟的 web tool、lobby 工具）
tool.notes: no page-level cap below the reference viewports; panels allocated proportionally (fr / % / cqw / minmax) and clamped in px only for intrinsic sizes; a cap above 1920px is a clamp, not a cap

diagram.zh: 圖為主載體（SVG 佔第一屏 ≥ 40%）
diagram.notes: the SVG scales to its container; a centred container with symmetric margins is fine, an off-centre one is not

dashboard.notes: auto-fit card grids; content sets row height, column count fills the width; a portal / launcher page (design-style-testbed T6 VIEWS, 5/5 PASS) is measured here

showcase.zh: 圖主展示頁（專案介紹、作品展示：滿版色帶＋置中內容，圖可出格）
showcase.notes: full-bleed painted bands without own text are backdrops and do not count as content (else every band page reads reach 100% and a left-capped column inside hides); content must be centred or reach >= 85% (a figure bleeding to the right edge reaches it); added 2026-10-02 with the figure-led page rule

content_classes.prose: read top to bottom; styling = AssetVault prose-doc-layer (rules/deliverable-doc-refs.md, prose bullet)
content_classes.node: scan and compare entities; a box per entity, colour per entity class (same rule, node bullet); NOT a presentation medium, outside references/design-axes
content_classes.figure-led: one claim + one evidence figure per unit (rules/deliverable-doc-refs.md figure-led page; decks add office-deck-deliverables P1-P5); cross-medium forms in references/design-axes
content_classes.diagram: the figure IS the page; representation chosen per diagram-authoring
